newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit sets US$36 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit sets US$36 mln loan.

text.p: The following transferable loan issue was announced by arranger Bankers Trust Co Hong Kong. BORROWER LEADING SPIRIT (HOLDINGS) CO LTD
AMOUNT US$36 MLN TYPE TRANSFERABLE LOAN
MARGIN L+150BP MATURITY 2.5 YRS AVG LIFE 2.15 YRS
PUTS NONE CALLS NONE LAUNCHED 03.DEC.96
DRAWDOWN -- AVAIL -- HOME CTRY HONG KONG
REPAYMENT THREE SEMI-ANNUAL UNEQUAL INSTALMENTS AFTER 18 MTHS'
GRACE PERIOD
GOV LAW HONG KONG REPLIES 23.DEC.96
NOTES PROCEEDS WILL BE USED FOR THE EXPANSION OF RETAIL
CHAIN STORES NETWORK, EXPANSION OF MANUFACTURING
CAPACITY AND FOR GENERAL WORKING CAPITAL.
ARRANGERS BANK OF COMMUNICATIONS HONG KONG BRANCH, BNP HONG
KONG BRANCH, BANKERS TRUST CO HONG KONG, DEVELOPMENT
BANK OF SINGAPORE HONG KONG BRANCH, INDUSTRIAL &
COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA SINGAPORE BRANCH AND
SUMITOMO BANK.
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
LEAD MANAGERS US$4 MLN+ 60BP ALL-IN 177.91
MANAGERS US$2-3 MLN 50BP ALL-IN 173.26
